profileReuse: N1 -> N2 -> N3; one owned DS profile and persistent WebKit store UUID

N1.purpose: real six-page configuration/import/layout/naming/policy/apply and dirty-save normal close

N2.purpose: selected reopen initialized/stopped; start, real client, typed ordinary/maintenance writes and active-listener close

N3.purpose: reopen discards runtime values; real single-connection close, dirty cancellation then discard normal close

inputMethod: fixed WebView DOM events and File/DataTransfer; normal ds_* UI IPC; no Vue internals, mock IPC, destroy or process exit
